misprints.note: Under Väktare the print clearly has ψ. The same word under Väktarinna and φύλακα have φ.
Under Välja, at the end of the strip, the second letter ψ is clearly printed. The word continues on the next page.
The abbreviation is printed as hd. 'hm' (hvem) follows in the same way.

uncertain.note: The mark on the iota of ίδος could be an acute or a smooth breathing. I chose the acute, since the genitive is φυλακίδος.
The accent on the first ἆρα is read as a circumflex like the one on ἆρ’, but it could be ἄρα.
The print shows a space before the colon, so I kept it. The same applies to 'σωτηρία, ἡ :' in 0519_02.
